title: Cargo Ships Grew To 24,327 Containers Without Bigger Crews
hook: One cargo ship now moves 24,327 containers with a tiny crew.
closing: Global trade now depends on huge ships and surprisingly few hands.
question: Would you join this cargo crew?

segments.say: Cargo capacity reached 24,327 containers, roughly six times the earliest ship shown.
A cargo ship reached 400 meters, stretching far beyond the Titanic.
Today's cargo crew fell to 20 people even as ships became enormous.
